The issue occurs when using Prettier in VS Code to format Markdown files containing raw HTML. Each time the file is saved, Prettier incorrectly increases the indentation of HTML blocks, causing them to be misaligned. This issue doesn't occur with nested code blocks as frequently, but is persistent with raw HTML.

### Root Cause Analysis
The bug is likely caused by the Prettier Markdown parser or printer that mishandles indentation of HTML blocks, confusing them with nested elements deserving additional indentation. This involves the Markdown table rows (`<tr>`) and cells (`<td>`) being incorrectly aligned upon each save, exacerbating with each save action.
